reviews.title: Great features for the price!
reviews.comment:
Easy fit for those systems where your x4 x8 x16 slots are all occupied!
I was worried I wouldn’t be able to get video on my rack but I ran across this little gem and I’m ecstatic!
It is EFI compliant so no need for CSM!
Uses approximately 10watts for general usage.
I would NOT recommend this for gaming, but it’s excellent for multitasking with the 4 HDMI outputs.
One con.
The card is compatible with a 1x slot, but the cards profile is tight to the pcie slot. Some M.2 motherboards heat sinks might prevent proper installation.
